dateLabel: first walls 7th century BCE; joined under the Qin
title: Great Wall of China begun
summary: Chinese states built defensive walls against steppe peoples; the Qin joined them together, and the Ming later built the best-known sections.
why: Its walls and trenches span about 21,196 km; it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

notes.problem: 'One of the largest building projects in history' is not in the source; source gives total length 21,196 km and UNESCO listing.
